_comment: EXE data tables. Types round 4 (docs/notes/types_4.md): the math and checksum tables. g_aSinTable is a quarter wave of sine at 90/4096 degree steps (stdMath_SinCos; cosine reads it backwards), g_aTanTable the same for tangent (stdMath_Tan), g_aCrc_table zlib 1.1.3's CRC-32 table. Round 5 (types_5.md): g_TextObjectCtx, the third text context beside g_PrintLineTextCtx and g_SubtitleTextCtx (sputText_MakeTextObjectL copies its 12 dwords); the phoneme table (46 entries: Phoneme_ToTalkChore's bsearch, sorted at start-up by sputActor); Blocky16's motion vectors (255 x, y pairs; the codec's configure step turns each into y * stride + x in g_asBlockyMotion). Round 6 (types_6.md): VbrAdpcm_Uncompress's IMA ADPCM step table (89 steps, 7..32767) and its bits per sample for each step index (4..7); stdColor_ColorConvertOneRow's 4x4 ordered-dither matrix (24 -> 16 bit colour).

structs.name: PhonemeEntry
structs.comment: One entry of g_aPhonemeTable: a phoneme of the lip-sync data and the talk chore it shows (Phoneme_ToTalkChore).
fields: the phoneme as its IPA code point (0x5f '_' silence, 0xe6, 0x28c, ...)
index of the costume's talk chore (CostumeNode.aTalkChores)

structs.name: BlockyMotionVector
structs.comment: One motion vector of Blocky16 (SMUSH video codec): a block's source offset in pixels.
